description: This file defines an abstract class 'TypedData' in the Drupal framework, serving as a base for typed data objects with methods for managing data definitions, values, constraints, validation, and hierarchical relationships.

classes.name: TypedData
classes.description: An abstract base class for typed data objects in Drupal, providing core functionalities such as data definition management, value handling, validation, and hierarchical relationships.

methods.name: createInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the TypedData class with specified definition, name, and parent.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a TypedData object with a data definition, optional name, and optional parent.

methods.name: getPluginId
methods.description: Returns the plugin ID based on the data definition's type.

methods.name: getPluginDefinition
methods.description: Retrieves the plugin definition for the data type.

methods.name: getDataDefinition
methods.description: Returns the data definition associated with this object.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the current value of the data object.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the value of the data object and optionally notifies the parent of changes.

methods.name: getString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the data value.

methods.name: getConstraints
methods.description: Retrieves validation constraints for the data.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the data using the validator service.

methods.name: applyDefaultValue
methods.description: Applies a default value (null) to the data object.

methods.name: setContext
methods.description: Sets the context with a name and parent data object.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the data property.

methods.name: getRoot
methods.description: Returns the root of the data tree.

methods.name: getPropertyPath
methods.description: Returns the property path within the data hierarchy.
